requirements.title: MOVE_ALLOC admits broad FROM forms and optional status arguments
requirements.definition: FROM may be of any type, rank, and corank; STAT and ERRMSG are optional arguments.

pending.MOVE_ALLOC-FROM-any-type: Use noncoarray allocatable integer, real, and derived-type FROM variables and verify the successful transfer facets. Mutate the declared type in the TO compatibility control so type admission alone is load-bearing.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-FROM-any-rank: Use scalar and rank-one noncoarray allocatable FROM variables and verify allocation status, bounds, and values after transfer. Mutate a rank-one case to scalar TO so the rank control fails source review.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-FROM-any-corank-out-of-scope: Out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision: corank admission is a coarray facet, and this packet creates no local-coarray plan.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-STAT-optional: Call MOVE_ALLOC once with STAT present and once absent on successful noncoarray transfers; the present case asserts zero and the absent case asserts the same allocation transfer effects.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-ERRMSG-optional: Call MOVE_ALLOC once with ERRMSG present and once absent on successful noncoarray transfers; the present case asserts unchanged text and the absent case asserts the same allocation transfer effects.

requirements.title: MOVE_ALLOC argument restrictions
requirements.definition: FROM shall be allocatable and not coindexed; TO shall be type compatible with FROM, have the same rank and corank, be allocatable and not coindexed, be polymorphic for polymorphic FROM, and have matching nondeferred declared type parameters; STAT shall be a noncoindexed integer scalar with decimal exponent range at least four; ERRMSG shall be a noncoindexed default character scalar.

pending.MOVE_ALLOC-FROM-allocatable: Positive source controls use allocatable FROM variables. A source-control mutation uses a nonallocatable FROM and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-FROM-not-coindexed-out-of-sco: Out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision: coindexed FROM is a coarray facet, and this packet creates no local-coarray plan.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-TO-type-compatible: Positive source controls use same declared type and an extension-compatible polymorphic pair. A source-control mutation changes TO to an incompatible type and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-TO-same-rank: Positive source controls use matching scalar and rank-one FROM/TO pairs. A source-control mutation changes only TO rank and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-TO-same-corank-out-of-scope: Out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision: corank matching is a coarray facet, and this packet creates no local-coarray plan.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-TO-allocatable: Positive source controls use allocatable TO variables. A source-control mutation uses a nonallocatable TO and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-TO-not-coindexed-out-of-scope: Out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision: coindexed TO is a coarray facet, and this packet creates no local-coarray plan.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-TO-polymorphic-for-polymorphi: Positive source control uses polymorphic allocatable FROM and polymorphic TO. A source-control mutation makes TO nonpolymorphic and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-TO-nondeferred-parameters-mat: Positive source control uses matching character LEN or PDT parameters. A source-control mutation changes a nondeferred parameter and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-STAT-noncoindexed-integer-sca: Positive source control passes a default integer scalar STAT initialized to a sentinel. Noninteger, array, or too-small-range mutations claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-ERRMSG-noncoindexed-default-c: Positive source control passes a default character scalar ERRMSG initialized to distinctive text. Nondefault-kind, array, or coindexed mutations claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MOVE_ALLOC successful transfer deallocates TO, moves FROM allocation, and unallocates FROM
requirements.definition: On successful invocation or STAT_FAILED_IMAGE assignment, allocated TO is deallocated, allocated FROM transfers its dynamic type, type parameters, bounds, cobounds, and value to TO, and FROM becomes unallocated.

pending.MOVE_ALLOC-deallocates-allocated-TO-on-e: Initialize TO allocated with distinctive old bounds and values, FROM allocated with different bounds and values, call MOVE_ALLOC successfully, and assert TO has only FROM's bounds and values. Mutate by omitting the prior TO allocation so the deallocation facet is not credited.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-transfers-dynamic-type-parame: Use allocated noncoarray FROM with nondefault lower bound, distinctive values, and a derived-type extension control; assert ALLOCATED(TO), bounds, SELECT TYPE dynamic type, and values after transfer. Mutate a bound or value expectation so the transfer check fails.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-cobounds-transfer-out-of-scop: Out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision: cobounds transfer is a coarray facet, and this packet creates no local-coarray plan.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-unallocates-FROM: Prefill FROM allocated, call MOVE_ALLOC successfully, and assert .NOT. ALLOCATED(FROM) paired with ALLOCATED(TO) and value checks so the unallocated result is not vacuous.

requirements.title: MOVE_ALLOC pointer association consequences
requirements.definition: Pointers associated with FROM on entry become correspondingly associated with TO when TO has TARGET; without TARGET, such pointer association status becomes undefined.

pending.MOVE_ALLOC-target-pointer-corresponding-: Use TARGET allocatable FROM and TO plus a pointer associated with FROM before the call; after successful MOVE_ALLOC, assert ASSOCIATED(pointer, TO) and transferred value through TO. Mutate by dropping TARGET from TO so the positive association check is not used.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-nontarget-pointer-association: No portable oracle: the pointer association status becomes undefined, so a conforming fixture cannot inquire, dereference, or compare that pointer after the call. Future fixtures must not observe this undefined status.

requirements.title: MOVE_ALLOC error handling uses termination, named image constants, or positive processor value
requirements.definition: On an error condition, absent STAT initiates error termination; present STAT receives STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE for stopped-image coarray cases, STAT_FAILED_IMAGE for failed-image coarray cases without another error, or another processor-dependent positive value distinct from those named constants.

pending.MOVE_ALLOC-failed-image-STAT-out-of-scop: Out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision: STAT_FAILED_IMAGE requires a failed image in the current team.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-other-error-positive-STAT-no-: No portable trigger: a conforming single-image program cannot require an other-error MOVE_ALLOC condition distinct from stopped or failed images.
pending.MOVE_ALLOC-other-error-STAT-value-latitu: No portable exact-value oracle: p7 permits a processor-dependent positive STAT value for other errors, constrained only to differ from the stopped and failed image constants.
